newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa August tractor sales up two-thirds yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa August tractor sales up two-thirds yr/yr.

text.p: South African tractor sales rose 67 percent in August to 546 from 328 a year earlier as farmers re-equipped on the back of expected strong earnings following this year's bumper harvest.
Tractor sales in the year to August total 3,824 units against 2,782 in the same eight months of 1995, the South Afican Agricultural Machinery Association (Saama) said.
Saama added sales may also have been boosted by pre-emptive buying ahead of expected price increases following the fall in the rand this year.
